DecisionInput.description: Journal of what `decision` really consumed, in order. t_ns = measurement/event/tick time.
DecisionInput.title: DecisionInput

DecisionTrace.description: Exactly one per (input_seq, arbiter): state, inputs used and why it spoke or not.
DecisionTrace.title: DecisionTrace

FrameMeta.description: t_ns = t_k (frame time from PTS), or s_n (schedule time) for a placeholder.
FrameMeta.title: FrameMeta

Measurement.description: One per FrameMeta (placeholders included); t_ns = t_k.
Measurement.title: Measurement

Q.description: A measured quantity; the unit lives in the field name (distance_m, ttc_s, ...).
Q.title: Q

RwConfig.description: No field can command the vehicle (NG1): extra="forbid" rejects anything not listed here.
RwConfig.title: RwConfig

SpeedSample.description: t_ns = t_recv (when the sample became available).
SpeedSample.title: SpeedSample

limitations: Not an approved or frozen v1.0 contract; known deviations remain in spec 12.3.
model_validator, reader compatibility and cross-stream checks are not fully expressed in JSON Schema.
Record input validators can fill schema/schema_version; writers emit these fields explicitly.
